info.name: QualORock
info.description: Scaffolded collection for the QualORock backend API, organized into one folder per feature. Folders are empty until each feature's endpoints are implemented (see infrastructure/tasks.md T12 DEFERRED notes) - populate with real requests generated from admin-panel, web-app, and landing-page-plans routes as those features are executed.

item.name: admin-panel
item.description: Endpoints owned by the admin-panel feature (Organizer/Venue/Event/Promoter/PlanPrice). No implemented endpoints yet.

item.name: web-app
item.description: Endpoints owned by the web-app feature (consumer User, Favorite/EventInterest, LGPD data-rights UI). No implemented endpoints yet.

item.name: landing-page-plans
item.description: Endpoints owned by the landing-page-plans feature. No implemented endpoints yet.
